svg.text: The Divided Kingdom to the Return
975 BC – 536 BC · after Sebastian C. Adams, Synchronological Chart (1871) · open data: Theographic (CC BY-SA 4.0), STEPBible, Wikidata
Upper streams follow Ussher's chronology as Adams did (Jones/Theographic). Lower streams follow modern reign dates. Red connectors join the same event in both.

g.title: Shishak invades Judah: Ussher 970 BC, modern 925 BC (-45 years)
Death of Ahab: Ussher 897 BC, modern 853 BC (-44 years)
Mesha of Moab rebels: Ussher 895 BC, modern 850 BC (-45 years)
Jehu becomes king of Israel: Ussher 884 BC, modern 841 BC (-43 years)
Menahem pays tribute to Pul: Ussher 771 BC, modern 738 BC (-33 years)
Fall of Samaria: Ussher 721 BC, modern 722 BC (+1 years)
Sennacherib invades Judah: Ussher 713 BC, modern 701 BC (-12 years)
Josiah killed at Megiddo: Ussher 610 BC, modern 609 BC (-1 years)
Battle of Carchemish: Ussher 607 BC, modern 605 BC (-2 years)
Jehoiachin surrenders to Nebuchadnezzar: Ussher 599 BC, modern 597 BC (-2 years)
Destruction of Jerusalem and the Temple: Ussher 588 BC, modern 586 BC (-2 years)

g.title: Evil-merodach releases Jehoiachin: Ussher 562 BC, modern 561 BC (-1 years)
Fall of Babylon: Ussher 538 BC, modern 539 BC (+1 years)
